While one spouse still works, the household is assumed to live on that salary and any benefits already claimed, without drawing on savings. Spousal and survivor benefits are not modeled.

Year-by-year plan for both accounts

Contributions stop when each spouse retires. Once you have both retired, withdrawals come from the two accounts in proportion to their balances.
